rationale: The workflow defines a two-cell matrix (x64, ARM64) for the Windows MSI build with fail-fast explicitly set to false. The P-LIT-FAIL-FAST pattern (cancel remaining matrix jobs after failure) directly targets this setting. When one platform cell fails, the windows_msi job fails regardless, so the dependent merge_msi job will not run; cancelling the surviving cell saves runner time without changing the pass/fail outcome of the required check or removing coverage for successful runs. The change is minimal (one value), adds no new network access, secrets, or privileged actions, and preserves all build steps and required checks. Evidence: the P-LIT-FAIL-FAST literature pattern reports matrix cancellation saves remaining work, and the synthetic experiment examples (scenario_passed) demonstrate fail-fast: false -> true on an equivalent matrix workload.
